note: InsuranceDekho is used here as an index of documents, never as a source of facts. Only files that are themselves a policy wording or a Customer Information Sheet are mirrored, and each was classified from its own first page because the site's link text mislabels brochures as policies and policies as brochures. Prospectuses and brochures found at the same URLs are recorded in the survey but deliberately not mirrored and not parsed: they summarise a contract and are superseded by it. sha256 and bytes are recorded so anyone can verify these are byte-for-byte what the CDN served. The PDFs themselves are stored under each insurer's own mirror directory (see mirrored_to) so the parsers find them where they expect; this directory is the index of what the aggregator led to.
